item_short_desc: Our Fast Mover Tactical Backpack is the go-to solution for quick access to your tactical gear and outdoor supplies, featuring a main compartment with 3 zippered mesh pockets and drawstring pouch, 2 additional zippered storage compartments, and 2 concealed side pockets, all equipped with two-way zippers for full access. The tactical pack has a 34L capacity and measures 9 inch x 12 inch x 19 inch, providing ample storage space for essentials, and is great for going to the range, trekking out into the wilderness, or stocking up as a bug out bag.
description: Our Fast Mover Tactical Backpack is the go-to solution for quick access to your tactical gear and outdoor supplies, featuring a main compartment with 3 zippered mesh pockets and drawstring pouch, 2 additional zippered storage compartments, and 2 concealed side pockets, all equipped with two-way zippers for full access. The tactical pack has a 34L capacity and measures 9 inch x 12 inch x 19 inch, providing ample storage space for EDC essentials, and is great for going to the range, trekking out into the wilderness, or stocking up as a bug out bag. Rugged Construction: Engineered with 600D polyester, these tactical military bags are built tough, withstanding strenuous activities while out in the field. From tactical operations to outdoor adventures, the MOLLE backpack keeps your gear safe and secure, no matter the mission. Ergonomic Design: The travel backpack features padded shoulder straps that naturally contour with your shoulders and a breathable padded mesh back for a comfortable carry. The backpack shoulder straps are also adjustable, allowing you to adjust the traveler bag when needed. The top carry handle provides quick and easy handling for when you are on the go. Ready for Action: The survival bag comes equipped with a removable sternum strap and removable waist strap for weight distribution when carrying heavy loads. Both straps feature a quick-release buckle for rapid and easy on/off. The side cinch straps provide additional adjustment when traveling. Utility at the Forefront: These MOLLE compatible backpacks consist of PALS webbing on the outside for mounting and securing additional tactical gear. In addition, these tactical rucksacks feature a rear hydration compartment with dual passthrough ports for a hydration hose, ideal for camping, hiking, and other outdoor activities. Please note, hydration system not included.
